meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 装好后,claude-mem 会在 Cursor 中启动本地 worker(默认),或连接你指定的远程 worker,并挂上 claude-mem-local / claude-mem-remote 的 MCP,让 Claude 通过它读写记忆。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上配置 claude-mem 时触发,涵盖本地或远程 worker、本地主机登录或 cmem.ai 远程推理 等场景。

say.text: 在 Cursor 上安装 claude-mem,用本地 worker
帮我配远程 worker,地址用我自己的服务器
把 observer 改成 host 本地登录
say.note: 加 --provider host,走本机回环 shim

howto.what_en: Once installed on Cursor, claude-mem starts a local worker by default, or connects to a remote worker, and exposes the claude-mem-local or claude-mem-remote MCP so Claude can read and write memory through it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you set up claude-mem on Cursor, covering local or remote worker, and local host-login or cmem.ai remote inference.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Cursor with the local worker
Set up a remote worker using my own server URL
Switch the observer to host local login
say_en.note: Adds --provider host via the loopback shim
